springWeb.checkApiVersioning.title: Warn when a request mapping uses the version attribute but the project configures no API versioning

springWeb.checkVersionFormat.title: Warn when the version attribute of a request mapping is not a major.minor.patch version

springWeb.checkInitBinder.title: Warn when an @InitBinder method returns a value or takes no WebDataBinder

springWeb.reportUnresolvedViews.title: Hint when a returned view name matches no template in the known template folders; quiet when a source defines its own ViewResolver

springWeb.showUrlMarkers.title: Show the URL of each request mapping in the gutter

springWebsocket.checkBrokerPrefixes.title: Warn when a @SendTo or messaging template destination is outside the configured broker prefixes

springGraphql.checkUnmatchedMapping.title: Warn when a mapping handler names a field the project's GraphQL schema does not declare

springGraphql.checkBatchMappingReturn.title: Warn when a @BatchMapping method returns a type Spring for GraphQL does not accept

springGraphql.reportUnmappedFields.title: Report (Info) a field with arguments on a schema type that no controller method or data fetcher serves

springCloud.checkStreamBindings.title: Hint when a StreamBridge destination or binder-specific key names a Stream binding that no configuration declares

springCloud.checkBootstrap.title: Warn when a bootstrap file is ignored because spring-cloud-starter-bootstrap is missing (Spring Boot 2.4+)

springCloud.checkLegacyStream.title: Check legacy @StreamListener / @SendTo channels, return values and @BootstrapConfiguration classes
